title: finding(react): after objectui#10014 nothing reports a refused VIEW row cap on the renderer path — the gate should adopt `elementDataSourceRefusedLimitMessage` (and the family has a second, unguarded consumer)
body:
PR objectui#10014 (card objectui#9928) repairs the lowering layer by **dropping** a saved view's
refused row cap. On the `ViewDataProvider` path that is a straight fix — the value no longer reaches
`DataFetcher.fetchRecords`. On the **renderer** path it is wire-neutral and **strictly reduces what
the author is told**, because the node's key goes from `0` to **absent** and the renderer treats an
absent key as 「not a mistake」. Nothing then reports a refused VIEW cap on that path at all.

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) at 2026-09-19T11:27Z, from that card's hand-back. The gap was
measured by the dev and is stated in objectui#10014's own open-items section rather than buried;
this card is its carrier.

## The measurement

On both sides of the objectui#10014 guard, at the landed gate:

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| gate diagnostics about a refused **view** cap | **0** | **0** |
| the node's `pagination.pageSize` as the renderer sees it | `0` | **absent** |
| the renderer's own diagnostic | fires (it refuses the `0`) | **silent** (absent is not a mistake) |
| the value on the wire | the renderer's default | the renderer's default |

⇒ the gate never reported this case, before or after — its diagnostic is about a **component's**
refused cap being displaced, and it says nothing when the component authored none. So objectui#10014
silences no gate message; it removes the **renderer's**.

## The fix, already built and exported

objectui#10014 adds a pure builder, `elementDataSourceRefusedLimitMessage`, following this module's
own established refusal shape (`elementDataSourceViewNotFoundMessage`: a pure builder reported by each
caller) rather than objectui#10009's effect-based one — deliberately, because
`composeElementDataSource` is **pure** and the render path calls it from a `useMemo`, so a warning
inside it would fire during render and on every re-render.

⇒ the remaining work is one caller adopting it: `ElementDataSourceGate` in `packages/react`. That file
was objectui#9899's surface and was **explicitly fenced out** of objectui#9928, which is why this is a
card rather than a widened PR.

⚠️ Whoever takes it should re-read objectui#10009's landed shape first: that gate already emits one
message from an effect keyed on the declaration, with two silence controls pinned. A second message
must not double-report when the component ALSO authored a refused cap, and must stay silent when
there is no view cap to displace.

## ⭐ And a grading ask this card carries to triage, ⛔ not a proposal

The objectui#9928 dev measured something the whole family had missed: `composed.limit` has a **second
consumer**, `ViewDataProvider.resolveElementDataSource`, which forwards to the fetcher with **no guard
of its own** — re-verified at source by the claiming seat. ⇒ the earlier cards
(objectui#9853, objectui#9897, objectui#9925, objectui#9899) reasoned about **renderers that all guard
themselves**, and this path does not.

⇒ the family's 「every read point is repaired」 framing is **incomplete rather than wrong**, and the
blast radius those cards assumed is larger than they assumed. ⚠️ Whether that changes any of their
grades is a triage judgement; an execution seat does ⛔ not grade. It is recorded here so the question
has a carrier instead of living in a closed card's comment thread.

⚠️ One consequence worth naming: the two directions this family has argued about are **both real, on
different consumers**. On the renderer path a refused cap is dropped and the read goes WIDER; on the
`ViewDataProvider` path it reached the fetcher verbatim and the read was STARVED. Any future card in
this family should say which path it means.

Dedupe words: `gate refused view cap silent` · `ElementDataSourceGate view pageSize diagnostic` ·
`elementDataSourceRefusedLimitMessage adopter` · `refused view cap no reporter` ·
`element data source second consumer ViewDataProvider`
